positions.title: Cloud Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed Grafana dashboards and integrated Prometheus data sources to monitor Maximo 8 Application Suites.
- Administered Grafana and Prometheus nodes within Kubernetes environments.
- Deployed Docker containers via GitLab CI/CD pipelines to support dashboard functionality.
- Collaborated with end-users to ensure dashboards met functional and performance requirements.

positions.title: Coding Instructor
positions.description:
- Utilized online tools and hardware to teach coding, robotics, and engineering (e.g. MakeCode, micro:bit).
- Guided 17 students through various game development, robotic programming, CAD modeling, and 3D animation projects.
- Engaged in 2 week long curriculum review to ensure specific learning standards and objectives.
